recommendations.proposal: C: Give repository reads explicit Result<Option<T>, E> contracts and distinguish persistence failure from domain outcomes. If separately approved, model enrichment states and successful completion explicitly, including the boundary before approval.
recommendations.benefit: Makes genuine absence, degraded operation and failed persistence distinguishable to callers instead of relying on logs or synthetic records.
recommendations.risk: Medium to high: changing failure propagation or completion/approval behavior is a contract change. The disabled enrichment path must not be reactivated as part of this recommendation.

recommendations.proposal: C: Add a report-generation seam using the existing provider abstraction, then test successful rendering, consent rejection and persistence/fallback failures. Consolidate repeated database fixtures using existing test-support components rather than introducing another harness; retain explicit checks for production constraints.
recommendations.benefit: Improves deterministic orchestration tests and reduces duplicated minimal-schema maintenance. Removes misleading reliance on obsolete Ollama configuration in Fireworks-era tests.
recommendations.risk: Medium: constructor/test-interface changes and isolated PostgreSQL prerequisites need care. Shared transport tests should be reused, not duplicated wholesale.

recommendations.proposal: C: Keep the existing pure cut/correction cores and shared STT/LLM clients, but separate harvesting process/OCR adapters from context persistence and report rendering from report storage. Put operational tool paths, deadlines and pricing behind typed configuration while preserving current defaults.
recommendations.benefit: Narrows change surfaces and makes failure injection easier without rebuilding existing transports or turning every algorithmic threshold into a configuration option.
recommendations.risk: Medium: cancellation cleanup, timing budgets, transactional replacement and local-only STT restrictions must remain unchanged. This is a refactoring proposal, not permission to generalize remote access.

recommendations.proposal: C: Correct provider/lifecycle documentation and explicitly identify active reporting, disabled enrichment/harvesting, and retained exported title-gate code. Keep deletion or reactivation outside this assessment.
recommendations.benefit: Reduces onboarding confusion and prevents dormant Rust ports or obsolete comments from being mistaken for competing live implementations.
recommendations.risk: Low for documentation clarification; removal or activation would require a separate product decision.
